title: Semantic Tube Prediction: Beating LLM Data Efficiency with JEPA
author: Hai Huang, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero
summary: The paper introduces Semantic Tube Prediction (STP), a new method to improve data efficiency in large language models. STP uses geometric ideas to keep token sequences on smooth paths, which helps models learn better with less data. Experiments show STP matches accuracy while using 16 times less training data than usual methods.
